title: Qualify Inbound Consulting Leads
summary: Every collab or consulting request gets a fit brief and a go or no-go summary, so you answer the good ones first.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you get more inbound requests than you can answer well.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (E) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You spend your time on the leads most likely to pay.
Nothing good gets lost in a busy inbox.
who_its_for: Consultants, freelancers and creators who get inbound requests.

stack.name: Lead Vetting
stack.role: Screens leads from your inbox and sends a short decision summary to Slack.
stack.creator: anzevoje

stack.name: Inbox Triage
stack.role: Sorts the rest of your email and DMs into tasks.

inputs.label: What a good lead looks like

steps.name: Lead Vetting
steps.does: Screens each lead and writes a fit brief

outputs: Go or no-go summaries in Slack
Time on the leads likely to pay

steps: Connect only the inbox and Slack workspace you own.
Write down what a good lead looks like for you.
Review a week of briefs and tune the criteria.
Reply to the top leads yourself.
guardrails: The bot never accepts a deal for you.
Treat briefs as input to your judgment.
